question: What recycling cost per kilogram does the review give for direct recycling?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%direct recycl%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%per kg%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%/kg%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%kg%' ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (6,9,10) AND (lower(text) LIKE '%cost%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%economic%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%$%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%usd%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%kg%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (6,7,8,9,10) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (9,10) AND line_no BETWEEN 0 AND 400 ORDER BY page, line_no

direct recycling potentially has both economic benefits

rendered: The review does not give a recycling cost per kilogram for direct recycling. It gives only a qualitative economic claim: life-cycle analysis and process-based cost models indicate that direct recycling potentially has both economic benefits[1]. It also says that the EverBatt model was developed to evaluate recycling cost and environmental effects, but no per-kilogram value for direct recycling appears in the text, tables or figures.[2]
